contentList.content:
Your Strength or Dexterity increases by 1.

Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery property of one weapon of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kind of weapon to another.

There are eight Weapon Masteries, each attached to specific a group of weapon types:

Cleave, Graze, Nick, Push, Sap, Slow, Topple and Vex.
